title: Ghost Gate
summary: Privacy Lab is the public demonstration of Ghost Gate access control. The current Crypt v3 policy checks a qualifying revealed/public native-tTARI output against a 100 tTARI threshold and issues a time-limited session. It does not provide a fully confidential aggregate-balance proof. The creator documents Sapient, embedded Web Tari Universe and Telegram admission; the operator and verifier remain trusted, and Telegram grants are not persistent across restart. October 31 review covered the original post, MIT source and live public policy page. The recording shows configuration and privacy limits without connecting a wallet, proving access or joining a group. Minotari XTM threshold-proof work remains research.
cardSummary: Check a testnet token threshold for access while keeping total wallet holdings outside the application’s request.
cardStatus: Web app · Testnet · Public qualifying output
creator: GSXRspartan
